items.summary_en: Rachael Stirling writes in her memoir All About My Mother that she has eaten some of her late mother Dame Diana Rigg's ashes An actress whose mother appeared in Game of Thrones has revealed that she consumed some of her late relative's ashes before a stage performance. Rachael Stirling has established a successful television and film career spanning several decades. The 49-year-old has appeared in productions including The Detectorists , The Bletchley Circle and The Game . She has also graced the stage alongside…
items.summary_zh: 瑞秋·斯特林在她的回忆录《关于我母亲的一切》中写道，她吃掉了已故母亲戴安娜·里格夫人的一些骨灰。一位母亲曾出演过《权力的游戏》的女演员透露，她在舞台表演前吃掉了已故亲人的一些骨灰。瑞秋·斯特林 (Rachael Stirling) 已建立了数十年成功的电视和电影事业。这位 49 岁的演员曾出演过《The Detectorists》、《The Bletchley Circle》和《The Game》等作品。什

items.title_en: ‘Pick it up’: Voice from above stuns Greater Noida man dumping garbage on street
items.title_zh: “捡起来”：上面的声音震惊了大诺伊达街上倾倒垃圾的男子

items.summary_zh: 大诺伊达 Beta 1 区的一名闭路电视操作员利用公共广播系统对一名试图在夜间倾倒垃圾的男子发出警告，警告他将被处以罚款，直到他捡起垃圾并走开为止。

items.title_en: 33 Stunning Photos Of Old Penn Station, Once An Architectural Marvel Before It Was Demolished
items.title_zh: 33 张旧宾夕法尼亚车站的令人惊叹的照片，在被拆除之前曾经是一个建筑奇迹
items.summary_en: Click here to view slideshow Before New York City's Pennsylvania Station became the busiest transit hub in the country — and one of the most reviled train stations in America — it was a classic example of beautiful Beaux-Arts architecture and the fourth largest building in the world. Now, decades after it was demolished and rebuilt to be completely underground, New York's plans to restore the former architectural landmark are underway. Take a look at Penn Station's complicated past. The Old Penn Station Getty…

items.title_en: The Extraordinary Story Of Unsinkable Sam, The Ship’s Cat That Allegedly Escaped Three Sinkings During World War 2
items.title_zh: 不沉的山姆的非凡故事，据称在第二次世界大战期间三次沉没的船上的猫
items.summary_en: Public Domain Georgina Shaw Baker’s 1940s portrait of Unsinkable Sam. In 1941, most newspapers were filled with reports of the latest World War II battles and casualty lists. But that November, a remarkable story emerged about an unexpected figure: a black-and-white cat dubbed Unsinkable Sam. The lucky feline — whose real name was Oscar — was found floating amidst the wreckage of the HMS Ark Royal after it was destroyed by a torpedo.
items.summary_zh: 公共领域 Georgina Shaw Baker 于 1940 年代创作的不沉山姆肖像。 1941年，大多数报纸都充斥着有关二战最新战役和伤亡名单的报道。但那年 11 月，出现了一个关于一个意想不到的人物的非凡故事：一只被称为“不沉的山姆”的黑白猫。这只幸运的猫科动物——真名叫奥斯卡——被发现漂浮在被鱼雷摧毁的皇家方舟号残骸中。

items.title_en: Kouri Richins Killed Her Husband With A Fentanyl-Laced Cocktail — Then Wrote A Children’s Book About Grief
items.title_zh: Kouri Richins 用含有芬太尼的鸡尾酒杀死了她的丈夫 - 然后写了一本关于悲伤的儿童读物
items.summary_en: Summit County Sheriff’s Office Kouri Richins, the Utah mother who was convicted of killing her husband by lacing his Moscow Mule with a lethal dose of fentanyl. In the early morning hours of March 4, 2022, Kouri Richins called 911 after finding her husband unresponsive in bed. She claimed that he’d had a shot of alcohol and a THC gummy before going to sleep, but a medical examiner later discovered that Eric Richins had overdosed on fentanyl. In the wake of Eric’s death, Kouri played the part of the grieving widow.
